newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic power steady amid mild weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic power steady amid mild weather.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. held steady Thursday against Wednesday's level amid outlook of mild weather for region, brokers and marketers said.
"They came down. Then it was bid up a bit," said a marketer who deals in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool.
The latest forecasts indicated temperatures in the Mid-Atlantic would be normal to above-normal next week.

Despite Wednesday's restarts of the 610 megawatt (MW) Oyster Creek nuclear power plant and 1,090 MW Susquehanna 1 nuclear power unit from refueling outages, participants were reluctant to take positions until the generating stations resume full output, brokers and marketers.
"We have to see how stable those nuclear units are," said another PJM trader.
The sharp decline in natural gas cash and futures prices was only a marginal concern in today's trading, according to market sources.
NYMEX November Henry Hub natgas futures midday Thursday fell as much as 11.5 cents to $2.460 per million British thermal units.
Firm, peak PJM electricity for Friday delivery was quoted at $20.25-$21.50 a megawatt hour (MWh), a tad higher than Wednesday's $20.00-$21.00 range.
Firm, off-peak power for Friday's light load hours in PJM was notationally assessed at $13.00-$13.50.
For the rest of October, PJM electricity for firm, peak delivery was pegged near $21.00.
November PJM electricity for firm, peak delivery was assessed at $22.60-$22.90, a narrower range than Wednesday's $22.65-$23.00.
December PJM power with similar delivery conditions was discussed between $27.65 and $27.90, compared with a range of $27.90-$28.20 on Wednesday.
January/February 1997 PJM deliveries were pegged at $31.75-$32.00, down from Wednesday's $32.00-$32.35.
First-quarter 1997 PJM electricity was valued at $29.50-$29.60, off slight from a quote of $29.60-$29.75 on Wednesday. A deal was heard done at $29.55.
Second-quarter 1997 power prices in PJM was quoted at near $22.00, compared with Wednesday's range of $21.80-$22.50.
July/August 1997 PJM deliveries were at $31.00-$32.00, flat from Wednesday.
